card.name: Verbs and links in climbing or news prose
card.fires_on: Single words in the middle of a sentence about mountain climbing (to, first, taken, 2 in a year) and a few other general web sentences. The word usually comes just before a verb or number completing the thought.

modes.label: Mountain climbing history
modes.description: Small words or digits in sentences about peaks, ascents and climbers such as Mallory.
modes.example: The peak was<< first>> climbed in 1953 by

modes.label: Other news prose
modes.description: A linking or auxiliary word in general news or opinion sentences, before the main verb phrase.
modes.example: Mr Erdogan has<< not>> said publicly whether he wants to become president

card.plain: It fires on small in-between words in mountain-climbing stories and some news sentences, with no medical meaning.
